blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY – The indigenous communities of the Cordillera were staggered last month by steep food and fuel prices that raised the inflation rate in the region to 8.2 percent in September, from the 6.8-percent rate since July, the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) said during an economic briefing on Thursday (October 15). This is the highest inflation rate yet this year in the highland region comprising Ifugao, Abra, Benguet, Apayao, Kalinga and Mountain Province, said Aldrin Federico Bahit Jr., PSA chief statistician for the region.
